drafted_from: tool row in tools/gather-words-from-people/tool-rows.json, do-work/gather-words-on-the-records-door.mjs, read-data/gathered-words.mjs and test/gather-words.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "I read Sam Example's words on list:praise and they are right: approve 'The cake was the best part of the day.' for showing." It runs tool:approve-words-to-show with decision approve and the exact words you reviewed.

lists.label: Praise
lists.holds: One row per person asked for their own words about a case: the words, the consent they gave, the reason it was the time to ask and where the row stands (asked, received, approved, declined or withdrawn).

values.words: The cake was the best part of the day.
values.consent_note: Replied: yes, first name is fine

alike: the reviews list in a help desk
a Notion table of customer quotes

instructions: 1. Pour the two example rows into the testimonials list you already keep (see pour), or make list:praise from the ten fields above and give it a gathers block saying which field is which.
2. Keep the person's words and consent first (tool:keep-the-words-a-person-gave), so the row is received.

3. Read the row's words, then say approve, decline or withdraw. To approve, the AI passes reviewed_words exactly as you read them; the call is refused if they differ from the words in the row or if the consent does not allow showing.
4. Read row_id and status (approved, declined or withdrawn). Words changed after approval stop showing until approved again.

worked_examples.title: Approve Sam's words exactly as reviewed
worked_examples.ask: Approve Sam Example's words on list:praise for showing.

input.reviewed_words: The cake was the best part of the day.

worked_examples.given: From tools/gather-words-from-people/test/gather-words.test.mjs (approval takes the exact words that were reviewed and pins them). list:praise must hold a gathers block (a bakery list shaped like the one in test/gather-words.test.mjs: consents full-name, first-name, no-name and private, anonymous heading 'A customer', ask subject 'How did the cake go, {name}?'). Sam's row is received with consent first-name, which allows showing.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"row_id":"record:praise:d9cbfc282b44d3c7c2029ca5d06c3c92","status":"approved"} (the row also gets an approved_identity pin of the speaker, words and consent; reviewed_words 'The cake was the best part.' would be refused as not the words now in the row; a consent of private is refused; decision withdraw answers status withdrawn and clears the pin).

pour.how: Name the testimonials list you already keep and its fields. The tool matches each of the ten fields of list:praise to one of yours (the map you give, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), refuses when fewer than 80% match, and otherwise answers the records:write that adds the two example rows to your list. The list also needs its own gathers block (which field holds the words, the speaker, the consent and the state, the consents and what each state is called) before these tools take it.
